summary: Develop industrial control systems, Python hardware-in-the-loop tests and CI/CD, and help adopt AI-assisted engineering tools.
requirements: Required: relevant bachelor or master degree, at most two years post-graduation professional experience, practical Siemens S7-1500 controls, Python and Git/CI/CD. No PhD and no previous CERN fellow/graduate contract. English with commitment to learn French.
compensation: CHF 5,266 or CHF 5,793 net per month, depending on degree; allowances may apply.
conditions: Hybrid in Geneva, 40 hours weekly; 24-month appointment, potentially 36 months. Target start March 2027; deadline 2026-12-01, 23:59 CET. CERN requires nationality of a Member or Associate Member State for this program; Brazil is an Associate Member according to https://home.cern/about/who-we-are/our-stakeholders. This is work in Geneva, not remote from Brazil.
